params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2  Area: site
Summary: Give the landing page one call to action that leads to a short self-assessment page: a few questions about the visitor's sector and how they verify claims today, answered with low-to-high sliders that work on a phone, ending in an offer to book a free 30-minute assessment.

## What is asked
- Questions, in the client's words: "what is your sector", "how often do you need to verify the authenticity of a claim?", "How far do you trust your current way of verifying?", "how fast can you verify a claim", "how costly is that verification", "how would your business be affected if verification fails". Possibly a few more about the type of business.
- A slider from low to high under each question.
- Closing offer, client's words: "Book a free assessment. In 30 minutes, we map your current verification process and identify where you lose time, money or trust".
- The answers are kept so Bextrust can see which sectors respond most.

## Open (needs a decision before building)
- Where the answers are stored and who reads them; the privacy page has to say so.
- How a booking reaches the team (calendar link, mail, form) and who takes the assessments.

Source: Portal mail:6 (feedback on the website content, forwarded by the owner). The client asks for the owner's view first, so this is a proposal to agree on before building.
params.title: One call to action: a sector self-assessment with sliders, ending in a free 30-minute assessment
